newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Dec construction costs fall 0.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Dec construction costs fall 0.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish construction costs fell 0.2 percent year-on-year in December after a fall of 0.4 percent in November, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Tuesday.
The construction costs index was unchanged month-on-month in December, SF said.
Year-on-year, material input costs rose 0.3 percent and labour costs rose one percent while other input costs fell 3.4 percent
Month-on-month, material costs fell 0.1 percent, labour costs rose 0.3 percent and other input costs were flat.
